notes: Introduces deterministic channel-content profiles around the existing Drafter without adding a new LLM/provider route.
Generated content is validated before Content Version creation and is never silently truncated to satisfy channel limits.
Existing provider publishing adapters reuse shared content-limit policy while retaining provider-specific account/media/API behavior.
A VS-30 API regression fixture is allowed only to remove a hard-coded schedule timestamp that became past during VS-31 CI; production scheduling rules are unchanged.
No new channel, OAuth flow, database migration, production enablement, deployment or real publication is authorized by this slice.

approvals.rationale: Owner prioritized roadmap capabilities through #13, granted standing implementation pre-approval after current work, and explicitly said Go next after VS-30 merged.
Approved PRD FR-05/FR-10/FR-11/FR-12/FR-15 and TRD already require replaceable channel adapters, channel fit and deterministic publishing.
Standing pre-approval covers implementation, tests, CI fixes and PR preparation for priority roadmap work; exact-SHA certification/merge/release/production gates remain separate.
Requires deterministic evidence and explicit approval bound to the final exact candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
Separate exact-SHA production-enable approval is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Channel executions are generated with explicit platform-aware guidance and rejected deterministically when they violate hard channel constraints, without changing publishing authority.
